# Speeir

> Speeir is a software agency based in Dublin, Ireland. It designs and ships its own software products before it ever touches a client's roadmap, then brings that same discipline to client projects across web, mobile, and custom software.

Speeir has delivered 50+ projects across six core disciplines, with a 98% client retention rate, and offers 24/7 support and monitoring after launch. Its teams work across borders with startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients internationally.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://speeir.com/services/web-development): Custom web applications built with modern technologies.
- [Mobile App Development](https://speeir.com/services/mobile-development): Native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
- [Custom Software Development](https://speeir.com/services/custom-software): Tailor-made software solutions for unique business needs.
- [Digital Marketing](https://speeir.com/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven strategies to boost online presence and growth.
- [E-Commerce](https://speeir.com/services/e-commerce): High-performance online stores with seamless user experience.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://speeir.com/services/maintenance-support): Ongoing technical support and optimization for digital products.
